preregistration.role: Purpose definitions, S4/G4/U4 representations, fresh histories, metric names, Reference ladder, hypotheses and decision-rule skeleton frozen before P1 Reference execution.

first_reference_execution.observed_by_designers: No Reference metric values or candidate values were inspected when later operational details were bound.

protocol_deviation.description: The labels 'FROZEN_BEFORE_ANY_P1_REFERENCE_RESPONSE' in later operational documents overstate the chronology. Execution had begun, although no completed Reference qualification result or Reference metric values had been inspected.
protocol_deviation.scientific_consequence: Do not claim strict pre-execution preregistration for the detailed aggregation operators or H4 numerical qualification details. Treat them as response-blind pre-candidate bindings. The earlier preregistered metric names, representations, workloads and high-level decision rules remain prospective.

non_changes: No metric name is added or removed.
No history, forcing, material or Reference grid is changed.
No observed Reference magnitude is used to choose an operator.
No candidate result exists at reconciliation time.
